messages.text: Morning all. Appraisal for the {{CLIENT_NAME:c_0167}} refi is now 9 business days out from order. AMC keeps saying "scheduling the inspection". Anyone else seeing this with the same vendor?
Yes, two of mine are stuck with them too. One has been in "assigned" status for a week with no appraiser name. I think they're short on certified appraisers in that county.
{{CLIENT_NAME:c_0167}} is mine. Rate lock on that one expires 9/4, so I need a real ETA, not a status label. Brandi, can you escalate with the AMC and cc me?
Will do. I'll ask for the appraiser's name and the inspection date in writing. If they can't give it by EOD I'll suggest we reassign to the backup panel.

Heads up for the pipeline review: {{CLIENT_NAME:c_0244}} commercial appraisal is also late. Original due date was 8/14 and the lender-ordered report still hasn't landed. Heidi is on PTO so I'm covering.
Lynn, what's the closing target on that one? If the report slips past next Wednesday I'll have to move the closing slot, and title is already booked for the 28th.
Target is still 8/28 but I wouldn't count on it. Client is flexible by a week or so, I already spoke with them. I'll confirm and let you know before you release the title slot.
Question for the group: for the lending-segment files, are we OK to accept a desktop appraisal or hybrid on anything under 70% LTV? Want to know before I ask the client about it.

Per the current credit policy, hybrid is allowed under 70% LTV for owner-occupied, but not for anything with a prior loan exception. {{CLIENT_NAME:c_0167}} has no exception on file that I can see, so should qualify.
Good, that's what I remembered. I'll still want Risk to sign off on the valuation method since it's a change from the original order. Jasmine, can you ping Lance in Credit Risk?
Sent him a note. Will post his answer here once I hear back.

Update from the AMC: they finally assigned an appraiser for {{CLIENT_NAME:c_0167}}, inspection set for Tuesday morning, report 3 business days after. That lands 8/27 at best. Tight but inside the lock.
OK, that works if nothing else slips. Keep the hybrid option warm as a fallback. Also please log the delay in the file notes so we have a trail if we need a lock extension.
Logged. I'll also request the extension quote from the investor now so we have a number ready, just in case.

Separate but related: {{CLIENT_NAME:c_0066}} closing docs are clean, but the appraisal is the only open condition. Not asking for anything, just flagging that it's the last thing blocking me from scheduling.
Checked the order for that one. It's with a different vendor and already has an inspection date of 8/24. Should be fine. I'll nudge them Monday for status.
Lance replied: Credit Risk is fine with hybrid on {{CLIENT_NAME:c_0167}} as long as the LTV stays under 70% and we document the reason for the change. No separate committee needed.
Perfect, thanks. We'll stay on the full appraisal for now and only switch if Tuesday's inspection falls through.
Confirmed with {{CLIENT_NAME:c_0244}}: they're fine moving closing to 9/4 if needed. Brandon, go ahead and hold the title slot loosely and I'll update you once the report is in.
